svg.title: The Strait of Hormuz
svg.desc: Situation map covering 45.8°E to 62.5°E, 21.0°N to 31.5°N. A reference plate: the Gulf, the Zagros, and twenty-one miles of water. Natural Earth physical geography; no thematic layer. Natural Earth 1:50m physical and cultural vectors; GMTED2010-derived texture-shaded relief.
